name: What is communism (ru -> en)
_about: Glossary for the whole booklet, built by build_glossary.py --lang en: names in the transliteration used by English Wikipedia, titles, formulas and terms as in the English editions of Progress Publishers and the Marx-Engels Collected Works (British spelling), the author's coinages, and the Marxist lexicon. Each source lists the inflected forms found in the Russian text, separated by '|', so TranslateBooksWithLLMs' per-chunk filter matches them. Use with: python translate.py ... --glossary english/glossary.ru-en.json
